csv_agency: State of Tennessee Department of General Services
csv_scope_of_work: The State of Tennessee, Department of General Services, State of Tennessee Real Estate Asset Management ( STREAM ), hereinafter referred to as the State, has issued this Request for Proposals ( RFP ), to define minimum contract requirements; solicit responses; detail response requirements; and, outline the State s process for evaluating responses and selecting a Construction Manager/General Contractor ( CM/GC ), to provide the needed services. The conservation hall work is to include replacement of the existing audio/ visual equipment, improving the kitchen hood exhaust, and the elevator scope of work as noted in the main residence scope. Wood deck and trim repair/replacement, soffit repair, HVAC upgrades, and Interior/exterior painting is also needed within the carriage house. Foundation/slab on grade/masonry wall structural remediation, and exterior painting is needed on the maintenance shop. HVAC/plumbing and electrical updates in the pool house. Lastly, the existing irrigation system will need new heads, controls, and expansion as well as the campus fire alarm replacement due to existing system no longer being supported

title: CM/GC for Tennessee Residence Update
short_description: CM/GC services for renovation and systems upgrades at the Tennessee Residence campus.
project_scope: Campus update and renovation works at the Tennessee Residence including conservation hall audio/visual replacement, kitchen hood exhaust improvements, elevator-related work in the main residence, wood deck and trim repair/replacement, soffit repair, HVAC upgrades, interior/exterior painting in the carriage house, foundation/slab-on-grade/masonry wall structural remediation and exterior painting at the maintenance shop, HVAC/plumbing/electrical updates in the pool house, irrigation system head/control expansion, and campus fire alarm replacement.
services: Construction Manager/General Contractor (CM/GC) services; disciplines requested include Design Build/Developer and Construction/Project Management.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a building renovation and campus systems upgrade project, not a bridge, long-span roof, stadium, or special structure.
- Scope is dominated by CM/GC and project/construction management rather than structural design services.
- Includes some structural remediation, but only as a minor part of a broader refurbishment package.
- Limited indication of architecturally demanding, innovative, or lightweight structural work relevant to sbp.
- Building type is a residence/support campus, not a university, cultural landmark, or major complex building.
construction_cost_explanation: Taken from the tender documents (Total Construction Cost: $3.4M).
fee_explanation: No explicit planning or engineering fee is stated. The procurement is for CM/GC services, so an sbp-specific design fee cannot be derived reliably from the notice.
references_qualifications: No specific reference or qualification requirements are stated in the provided notice excerpt.
